introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.p1: MakerFlow is an application designed for content creators. It lets you connect social media accounts (Instagram, YouTube) to view performance analytics on your posts, and to write scripts for your content.
introduction.p2: This privacy policy describes the data we collect, how we use, store and protect it, and your rights as a user.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data collected
dataCollected.intro: When you connect a social media account to MakerFlow via the OAuth protocol, we collect and store the following data depending on the platform:

instagram.title: Instagram
analyticsItems: Reach, views, likes, comments, shares, saves

youtube.title: YouTube
channelItems: Channel ID, channel name, custom URL
analyticsItems: Breakdown by country, subscription status and content type (live / on-demand)

auth.title: Authentication data (all platforms)
items: OAuth access and refresh tokens (encrypted at rest, never exposed to the browser)

dataUsage.title: 3. Data usage
dataUsage.intro: The data collected is used exclusively to:
items: Display your performance analytics in your personal dashboard
Periodically synchronize your data to keep your analytics up to date
Notify you when your connection to a platform expires or is revoked
dataUsage.outro: Your data is only accessible by you. We do not sell, rent or share your data with any third party for commercial or advertising purposes.

storage.title: 4. Storage and security
storage.intro: We implement appropriate technical measures to protect your data:
items: OAuth access tokens are encrypted at rest
Data is stored in a secure database with restricted access
Communications between your browser and our servers are encrypted via HTTPS

sharing.title: 5. Data sharing
sharing.paragraph: MakerFlow does not share your data with any third party. Data obtained via the platforms' APIs is processed in accordance with the <metaLink>Meta Platform Terms</metaLink> and the <youtubeLink>YouTube API Services Terms of Service</youtubeLink>.

retention.title: 6. Retention and deletion
retention.intro: Your data is retained for as long as your MakerFlow account is active.
items: When you disconnect an account (Instagram or YouTube) from MakerFlow, the analytics data already collected is retained to preserve your statistics history
When you delete your MakerFlow account, all of your data is permanently deleted

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.intro: As a user, you have the right to:
items: Access the data we hold about you
Request the deletion of your data at any time
Disconnect your accounts (Instagram, YouTube) from the application settings
Revoke MakerFlow's access from your Instagram or YouTube account settings
